eeg_respiration_association.claims_boundary: Exploratory association of one-second EEG and belt sample means only. It cannot distinguish neural coupling, movement, reference pickup, shared trends, or coincidence. No causal, artifact-identification, respiration-rate, phase-locking, or clinical claim is supported; autocorrelated windows are not independent trials and no significance test is performed. Recorded LSL clock correction does not establish sensor latency or physiological synchrony.
eeg_respiration_association.method: Fixed 60-second nonoverlapping windows; zero-lag Pearson r of one-second arithmetic sample means; two boundary bins excluded on each side.
eeg_respiration_association.raw_clock_policy: Original XDF untouched; pyxdf synchronize_clocks=True, dejitter_timestamps=False.
eeg_respiration_association.derived_clock_policy: Integer-second bins on the corrected recorded LSL axis; no interpolation, extrapolation, timestamp rewriting, lag optimization, or cross-gap concatenation.
analysis_specific_cautions: Exploratory association of one-second EEG and belt sample means only. It cannot distinguish neural coupling, movement, reference pickup, shared trends, or coincidence. No causal, artifact-identification, respiration-rate, phase-locking, or clinical claim is supported; autocorrelated windows are not independent trials and no significance test is performed. Recorded LSL clock correction does not establish sensor latency or physiological synchrony.
Bin averaging is a descriptive aggregation, not a validated anti-aliasing or EEG-cleaning pipeline.

aligned_trace_figure.boundary: Shape-only standardized one-second means, not raw data or evidence of physiological synchronization; human privacy review required.

timing.sample_loss_note: Timestamp gaps are observations, not independently verified packet loss. Device counter evidence must use its reviewed native stride.

channel_integrity.scope: Channel-specific findings remain visible; analysis chooses usable channels/windows, not this heuristic percentage.

acquisition_context.boundary: Historical acquisition preflight only; not a fresh assessment of recorded data. Missing historical reports do not block analysis. Bench labels and failures are not erased by later QC.

analysis_specific_readiness.interpretation: QC completion is not a universal fitness certificate. Each later analysis must check duration, continuity, channels, units, reference, and its own assumptions; warnings are retained.
